name: Find or Create User
plugin_description: Integrates with Zendesk to manage support tickets from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Looks up a Zendesk end user by Zendesk User ID, External ID, email, or name, trying each one provided in that priority order until one matches, optionally creating them if none does.

inputs.name: zendesk_user_id
inputs.label: Zendesk User ID
inputs.hint: Zendesk's own internal numeric user ID (not External ID — see that field for the distinction). Highest-priority search key — a direct, unambiguous record fetch, tried before External ID, Email, or Name. If it finds no match, the other provided keys are still tried in order.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.label: External ID
inputs.hint: e.g. a Kizen contact ID, stored on the Zendesk user record for cross-referencing. Tried (via Zendesk's guaranteed-unique external ID lookup) if Zendesk User ID isn't set or found no match, before Email or Name. Also stored on the record when creating a new user.

inputs.name: user_email
inputs.label: Email
inputs.hint: Tried if Zendesk User ID and External ID are unset or found no match, before Name. Also used to create a new user if Create If Missing is enabled.

inputs.name: user_name
inputs.label: Name
inputs.hint: Lowest-priority search key — tried only if Zendesk User ID, External ID, and Email are all either unset or found no match. Required if Create If Missing is true and no user matches yet. Name matching is fuzzy — if more than one user matches, the action raises an error rather than guessing.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.label: Phone
inputs.hint: Only used when creating a new user.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.label: Organization ID
inputs.hint: Numeric Zendesk organization ID — visible in the organization's URL under Admin Center → People → Organizations. Only used when creating a new user.

inputs.name: create_if_missing
inputs.label: Create If Missing
inputs.hint: If true and no user matches, creates one. Defaults to false — no user is created otherwise.

outputs.name: was_created
outputs.label: Was Created
outputs.hint: True if a new user was created; false if an existing user was found.
